answer: The garden report publishes the merge explicitly at each nebula. Each collapsed cluster gets one haven weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 256 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 269 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3867 identities would post 4045 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
